MetaBlooms OS — Export Gate (MB-GATE-EXPORT-001)
===============================================

This gate guarantees that OS exports behave exactly like the successful export you just received.

Rules:
- Export ONLY the canonical OS zip and governance/bootstrap artifacts.
- NEVER export WORKING_OS or SCRATCH.
- Produce a single, deterministic ZIP.
- Fail closed if invariants are violated.

Usage (Sandbox/Linux):
  bash export.sh /mnt/data/Metablooms_OS /mnt/data/MetaBlooms_OS_EXPORT.zip

Usage (Windows):
  .\export.ps1 -Root "C:\Metablooms_OS" -Out "C:\MetaBlooms_OS_EXPORT.zip"
